description: 10일 정산 회계장부: 지출내역, 수입내역(축사, 개인실 업무), 수입 대 지출 결산을 쪽별 화면으로 보여 주고 다음 표시로 넘긴다. 현물(재료·보관 아이템)은 금액에 합산하지 않고 수량만 적는다.

add_locations.name: jo9_ledger
add_locations.body:
if $args[0]='decade': ! Decade ledger pages: expenses, income, in-kind income and the settlement, paged with the forward mark. local jo9_led_in, jo9_led_net, jo9_led_room, jo9_led_k local $jo9_led_b, $jo9_led_t local jo9_led_ok ! ledger cutscene by house: content/pic/scene/home/jo9_ledger_ plus the lower case estate name plus .png, then jo9_ledger.png, then the study as the last fallback $jo9_led_bgpath='' jo9_led_ok=0 $jo9_led_t='jo9_led_ok = %content/pic/scene/home/jo9_ledger_'+$lcase($estate)+'.png%' dynamic $jo9_led_t if jo9_led_ok=1: $jo9_led_bgpath='content/pic/scene/home/jo9_ledger_'+$lcase($estate)+'.png' if $jo9_led_bgpath='': jo9_led_ok=0 dynamic 'jo9_led_ok = %content/pic/scene/home/jo9_ledger.png%' if jo9_led_ok=1: $jo9_led_bgpath='content/pic/scene/home/jo9_ledger.png' end jo9_led_room=jo9_led_street+jo9_led_fog+jo9_led_item jo9_led_in=barn_total_profit+jo9_led_room killvar '$text' killvar '$jo9_led_ttl' jo9_led_pn=1 $text[1]=$bill_message $jo9_led_ttl[1]='지출내역' jo9_led_pn+=1 $jo9_led_pg='
지난 주기 수입내역

' if barn_total_profit ! 0: $jo9_led_b=$barn_accounts jo9_led_k=instr($jo9_led_b,' 이윤 총계') if jo9_led_k>0: $jo9_led_b=$mid($jo9_led_b,1,jo9_led_k-1) $jo9_led_b=$replace($jo9_led_b,'
축사 장부

','') $jo9_led_pg+='[축사]
'+$jo9_led_b if barn_total_profit>0: $jo9_led_pg+='축사 총계: + $'+str(barn_total_profit)+'

' else $jo9_led_pg+='축사 총계: - $'+str(-barn_total_profit)+'

' end end $jo9_led_pg+='[개인실 업무]
' if jo9_led_street>0: $jo9_led_pg+='길거리: + $'+str(jo9_led_street)+'
' if jo9_led_fog>0: $jo9_led_pg+='안개 경계 탐색: + $'+str(jo9_led_fog)+'
' if jo9_led_item>0: $jo9_led_pg+='아이템 매각: + $'+str(jo9_led_item)+'
' if jo9_led_room<=0: $jo9_led_pg+='수입이 없었다.
' $jo9_led_pg+='개인실 총계: + $'+str(jo9_led_room)+'
' $text[jo9_led_pn]=$jo9_led_pg $jo9_led_ttl[jo9_led_pn]='수입내역' if $produce_msg ! '' or jo9_led_mat>0 or jo9_led_keep>0: jo9_led_pn+=1 $jo9_led_pg='
지난 주기 수입내역 - 현물

' if $produce_msg ! '': $jo9_led_pg+=$produce_msg+'

' if jo9_led_mat>0 or jo9_led_keep>0: $jo9_led_pg+='[개인실 업무]
재료 '+str(jo9_led_mat)+'개 수령
아이템 '+str(jo9_led_keep)+'개 보관

' $jo9_led_pg+='현물은 결산 금액에 포함하지 않습니다.' $text[jo9_led_pn]=$jo9_led_pg $jo9_led_ttl[jo9_led_pn]='수입내역: 현물' end jo9_led_pn+=1 jo9_led_net=jo9_led_in-final_payment $jo9_led_pg='
지난 주기 결산

' if barn_total_profit>0: $jo9_led_pg+='축사 총계: + $'+str(barn_total_profit)+'
' elseif barn_total_profit<0: $jo9_led_pg+='축사 총계: - $'+str(-barn_total_profit)+'
' end $jo9_led_pg+='개인실 총계: + $'+str(jo9_led_room)+'
' $jo9_led_pg+='수입 합계: ' if jo9_led_in>=0: $jo9_led_pg+='+ $'+str(jo9_led_in)+'
' else $jo9_led_pg+='- $'+str(-jo9_led_in)+'
' end $jo9_led_pg+='지출 총계: - $'+str(final_payment)+'
' $jo9_led_pg+='--------------------------
' if jo9_led_net>=0: $jo9_led_pg+='결산: + $'+str(jo9_led_net)+'' else $jo9_led_pg+='결산: - $'+str(-jo9_led_net)+'' end $text[jo9_led_pn]=$jo9_led_pg $jo9_led_ttl[jo9_led_pn]='결산' jo9_led_street=0 jo9_led_fog=0 jo9_led_item=0 jo9_led_mat=0 jo9_led_keep=0 exit end

add_locations.name: jo9_ledger_view
add_locations.body:
! Decade ledger viewer: one page per screen, the engine forward and back marks turn the pages. *clr & cla & killobj $return_lock='jo9_ledger_end' gs '_layout' $place='study' if $jo9_led_bgpath ! '': *p func('interior_change', 'jo9_html', '
') else *p func('interior_change', 'jo9_html', '
') end *p '
정산 장부
<<$jo9_led_ttl[txt]>>
쪽 <> / <>
' *p '
<<$text[txt]>>
' if txt아래의 다음 표시를 누르면 장부를 넘깁니다.' else *p '
마지막 쪽입니다. 다음 표시를 누르면 정산을 마칩니다.
' end if txt>1: addobj '' addobj ''

add_locations.name: jo9_ledger_end
add_locations.body:
! Decade settlement after the ledger pages: the rest of the original decade block.
$return_lock=''
decadecount = 0
decade += 1
decadesave = 1

sparks += barn_total_profit
if final_payment > sparks and exam_in_progress ! 1:
 gs 'jo9_liquidation', 'begin'
 gt 'jo9_liquidation', 'view'
else
 sparks -= final_payment
end

!Refresh all databases - crushboss
gs 'interior_storage'
gs 'refresh_database'
gs 'interior_restore'
gt 'menu_form'

edits.old:
gs 'billing'
	msg '<<$bill_message>>'
	barn_report_available = 0
	if barn_total_profit ! 0:
		msg '<<$barn_accounts>>'
		barn_report_available = 1
	end
	if assistant_quiet_rule = 1 and $produce_msg ! '': msg $produce_msg

	decadecount = 0
	decade += 1
	decadesave = 1

	sparks += barn_total_profit
	if final_payment > sparks and exam_in_progress ! 1:
! JO9 MOD START INSOLVENCY_BILL_BEGIN_20261023 | 2026-10-23_insolvency_asset_liquidation
		gs 'jo9_liquidation', 'begin'
		gt 'jo9_liquidation', 'view'
! JO9 MOD END INSOLVENCY_BILL_BEGIN_20261023
	else
		sparks -= final_payment
	end

	!Refresh all databases - crushboss
	gs 'interior_storage'
	gs 'refresh_database'
	gs 'interior_restore'
	gt 'menu_form' &! refresh menus and mood to reflect potential changes from billing
edits.new:
! JO9 MOD START DECADE_LEDGER_20261109
	gs 'billing'
	barn_report_available = 0
	if barn_total_profit ! 0: barn_report_available = 1
	gs 'jo9_ledger', 'decade'
	txt = 1
	$return_lock = 'jo9_ledger_end'
	gt 'jo9_ledger_view'
	! JO9 MOD END DECADE_LEDGER_20261109
